All 14 tests pass.

🟢 Green Phase Complete:

**Implementation**: Added `CURSED_SURCHARGE_RATE = 0.5` and an `itemSurchargesForItems` helper in `/home/experimenter/experiments/runs/2026-07-26_00-13-47_claim-office-example-mapping_v4-exact-subagents_opus-5-no-thinking-3/src/claim-office.ts`, summing 50 % of each cursed item's own base premium. The result is added to the policy base premium alongside the existing first-insurance surcharge, which still uses the untouched policy base premium.

**Result**: All tests now pass (14 passing, 34 todo)

**Approach**: This is minimal — only the cursed flag is handled, no enchantment-level surcharge, no other item modifiers. The `itemSurchargesForItems` reducer is the smallest structure that keeps item surcharges out of the first-insurance base, which the test's expected 101 (60 + 30 + 6 + 5) demands. All previously green tests have no cursed items, so their surcharge total is 0 and their premiums are unchanged.

Proceeding to Refactor phase.
